statement: An entity is required to be registered for GST if it is carrying on an enterprise and its GST turnover meets the registration turnover threshold — $75,000 as specified in the regulations ($150,000 for a non-profit body) — and it must apply for registration in the approved form within 21 days after becoming required to be registered.
caveat: The Act states base thresholds of $50,000 and $100,000 with the operative amounts set by the regulations; taxi and ride-sourcing enterprises must register regardless of turnover, and special rules in Chapter 4 adjust who must register. Voluntary registration below the threshold is available under section 23-10.
